create_graph_sampler_ensemble: create a GraphSamplerEnsemble to run parallel graph subgraph sampling with mixed C++ and Python backends
run_par_sample_ensemble: run par_sample_ensemble to sample subgraphs from a graph for node or link prediction tasks
shuffle_targets: shuffle node targets across all sampler backends for stochastic sampling during training
set_return_target_only: set return_target_only flags per sampler to control whether full subgraphs or target-only results are returned
validate_epoch_end: validate epoch end by checking C++ sampler root index and sequential traversal state
